items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Did you meet Jill [his wife] in high school? ... I saw Jill when I was 15 years old... immediately it was like oh my Lord, you know, who is that? How can I get next to her?

ctx.x: Wow. Did you meet Jill [his wife] in high school?

I saw Jill when I was 15 years old. I was on a gig at Montgomery Wards in Rome, a live radio broadcast with Al Serway and Joe Abbis and Anthony Elliot, the great cellist, who was playing bass in those days, and Dave Derby was the announcer. How’s that for remembering something.
Where are you going this afternoon? Do you remember that? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -17-
